svg.title: Shadow - MCP OAuth Tokens, Rotation And Revocation (TASK-069F, behind MCP_ENABLED)

g.text: Shadow - MCP OAuth Tokens, Rotation And Revocation (TASK-069F, behind MCP_ENABLED)
Public endpoints, form-encoded, rate-limited per client IP
(token and revoke buckets), Cache-Control: no-store, RFC 6749 errors.
Tokens are opaque 256-bit values; only SHA-256 hashes are stored or compared.
No token, code or request id is ever logged.
Best-effort lazy cleanup (SKIP LOCKED, one commit per step,
500 ms lock_timeout): expired requests, expired access tokens,
revoked or expired grants (tokens cascade, references set null),
Revoke the request's active grant and all its tokens
[valid client, unexpired code, same redirect URI,
PKCE S256 verifier, same canonical resource]
Advisory lock per client + User + resource, then reuse
the User's active grant (revoke its earlier tokens, keep expires_time)
or create a grant expiring in 30 days
Insert access (1 h) and refresh (7 d idle) token hashes,
Throttled client last_used_time (may wait for an
Lazy cleanup, then lock grant, then token
Revoke the grant and all its tokens
Insert new pair; set only old row's replaced_by_hash
token unexpired and unrevoked, grant active and bound to
this resource, User not soft-deleted, current role re-read,
effective scopes = grant scopes intersected with role scopes.
Grant last_used_time at most every 5 minutes.
Refresh token: revoke grant and its tokens.
Access token: revoke only that token.
(session, CSRF, exact Origin; own grants only)
Revoke grant and its tokens (revoked_by = User)
Revoke every active grant of that User
Every grant revocation is logged at INFO to stderr (own handler) with actor,
User id, grant key, client_id, self-declared client name, reason and revoked
The connections API stays registered with MCP_ENABLED=false.
